task.title: Supersede the misleading 2026-07-29 one-changed refresh evidence
task.description:
The committed 2026-07-29 repository evaluation reports a projection-refresh-one-changed measurement that does not measure what its name claims. That scenario mutated its task through 'workbook update', which calls the projection updater's Advance for the task it mutates, so the refresh that followed observed zero stale task heads rather than one.

The 2026-07-30 many-changed refresh work corrected the harness to mutate task heads by writing Git objects directly, and verifies the exact changed-head cardinality with a ref diff before each measured refresh. Corrected numbers are in docs/performance/2026-07-30-projection-refresh-sha1.json and the SHA-256 companion: 67.54 ms for zero changed heads and 99.17 ms for one, against the superseded figure.

The stale number remains in the repository presented as a one-changed refresh. Annotate or supersede the 2026-07-29 evidence and its surrounding narrative so no reader treats it as a valid one-changed measurement.

Acceptance: the 2026-07-29 evidence carries an explicit correction pointing at the 2026-07-30 reports, existing raw evidence files stay immutable, and docs/performance/README.md does not describe the superseded number as valid.
